BAJAJ ALLIANZ HEALTH INSURANCE PLANS THAT COVER CORONAVIRUS
Bajaj Allianz Individual Health Insurance Plan (Individual Health Guard):
A personal health insurance plan that ensures that you are comprehensively covered for any health related emergency.

An individual health insurance policy covers you for COVID-19 hospitalization expenses, covers day care procedures, pre and post hospitalization expenses, road ambulance expenses and organ donor expenses. You can also choose from multiple sum insured options ranging from INR 1.5 lakh to INR 50 lakh.
Bajaj Allianz Silver Health Insurance plan:
A health insurance that covers COVID-19 hospitalization expenses for the elderly.

Health insurance for senior citizens ensures that you do not spend all your savings on health in your old age. With this plan, you get financial security for, hospitalization, medical check-ups, pre, and post-hospitalization expenses. And, you also get a 5% family discount for each member of your family and customized packages to suit your requirements.

Arogya Sanjeevani Plan:
A standard health insurance plan, the Arogya Sanjeevani policy covers you for COVID-19 hospitalization expenses, daycare procedures, AYUSH treatment, daycare treatments, road ambulance expenses, cataract treatment, and many listed modern treatment methods.

Benefits
If a person is first diagnosed with COVID-19 during the policy period, we will pay the entire Sum Insured, as specified in the Policy Certificate against this cover, as a lump sum amount. Ambulance Assistance: We will provide assistance in arranging for an ambulance in case of any medical need. The service can be availed an unlimited number of times. The cost of transportation will have to be borne by the insured.
Conditions for claim eligibility
The diagnosis must be confirmed by only those specific test(s) as defined by government authorities
The test for Novel Coronavirus should be conducted in National Institute of virology, Pune or any other Government designated laboratory in India, appointed for testing of COVID-19
The lab diagnosis must have been performed after the initial waiting period of 14 days.
Exclusions:
Any travel history post-Dec 31, 2019, to any affected area overseas
Any history of quarantine or diagnosis with COVID-19 prior to the risk inception or within the waiting period of 14 days
Any claim within the first 14 days after policy inception
Documents Required
In the event of a claim, we must be intimated immediately but no later than 30 days from date of event/diagnosis. We must receive below mentioned mandatory documents for claim processing

Duly filled claim form by the Insured Person/claimant.
Lab report with sign and stamp, confirming positive for Coronavirus.
The insured must have been tested positive for COVID-19 in the National Institute of Virology, Pune or any other Government-authorized laboratory in India.
Certificate from Government medical officer confirming the diagnosis or from any medical practitioner authorized by government to issue such certificates
Declaration of “No travel” post 31 Dec 2019, (format will be shared shortly)
Any treatment papers, Doctor’s Certificate, Discharged Summary, other Investigation reports
Canceled cheque and NEFT mandate form - duly filled in by the Insured Person/claimant
Terms & Conditions
Waiting period: Initial Waiting period of 14 days (Not applicable to VAS or Add on coverage)
Age: 18-75 yrs
No survival period
1 year policy period
The scope of cover shall be within the geographical boundaries of India and restricted to Indian nationals only
Frequently Asked Questions
What is covered under the policy?
The first diagnosis of COVID-19. This includes value-added services like Health assistance benefit and chat/virtual consultation. There is an add-on coverage which includes teleconsultation and ambulance assistance
Do you pay only in case of hospitalization due to COVID-19?
No, we will pay the entire Sum Insured on the first diagnosis of COVID-19, irrespective of hospitalization.
What is the policy period?
Policy Period is 1 year
Is there any waiting period applicable to the policy?
Waiting Period is of 14 days
What is the Survival period?
Survival period means the minimum no. of days insured has to be alive post the diagnosis to avail the Benefit
Is the survival period applicable under the policy?
No, there is no survival period.
Is it indemnity cover or a benefit cover?
It is a benefit policy.
What is Benefit cover?
It is a cover where we pay the entire Sum Insured(usually as a lump sum) once the insured event is triggered
What is the minimum age eligibility for the product?
Minimum age -18 years.
What is the maximum age eligibility for the product?
Minimum age -75 years.
